Job Specifications Industry : General Contracting / Facility Management / Engineering Consultancy Experience : ▸ 4 to 6 years of experience in construction site supervision, facility maintenance. ▸ Experience must have been gained in contracting, construction, engineering consultancy, or facility management environments ▸ Experience directly supervising multi-trade crews of electricians, plumbers, masons, and finishing trades ▸ Familiarity with daily site reporting and material management. Education : ▸ Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline ▸ Professional accreditation with the Saudi Council of Engineers is required.
